name: Stremio tvOS (Unofficial AltStore Source)
subtitle: Freedom to stream — unofficial AltStore-compatible source for Apple TV.
description: An unofficial AltStore source for Stremio on Apple TV (tvOS), compatible with any signing app that consumes the standard AltStore source format (Feather, AltStore Classic, ESign, Scarlet, Sideloadly, and others). NOTE: Stremio uses the same bundle identifier (com.stremio.pal) on both iOS and tvOS; most signing apps do not allow two apps with the same bundle ID in one source, so tvOS is published as a separate JSON file. For iOS / iPadOS add the separate source: stremio-ios.json. Stremio's official source uses Apple's encrypted App Store Connect marketplace manifest format and cannot be parsed by most signing apps; this source points to plain tvOS IPA artifacts publicly available on the dl.strem.io CDN.

apps.localizedDescription: Stremio for Apple TV (tvOS), full-featured PAL build. Requires tvOS 15.0+. When installing pick the Stremio (PAL) entry inside this source; the iOS source uses the same bundle ID and may conflict — remove the iOS source if needed.

feat: add download Live Activities on iOS 16.2 and later
feat: add in-app storage management for reviewing and clearing cached data
feat: add subtitle Live Sync for quickly correcting subtitle timing
feat: scroll to the top when the active tab is tapped again
feat: add gradient fade edges to the profile picker
fix: correct toast positioning
fix: refresh content correctly after selecting a profile
fix: prevent Discover crashes and resolve the “See All” loading race condition
fix: prevent downloads from becoming stuck in a frozen state
fix: resume interrupted downloads when selecting “Retry”
fix: open the offline copy when a downloaded video URL is selected
fix: warn when hardware decoding is unavailable and software decoding is used
fix: correct subtitle offset behavior
fix: detect external displays when the app initially launches
fix: hide video content from app-switcher snapshots
fix: make play and pause respond immediately when the controls are hidden
fix: improve KSPlayer playback of high-bitrate content

### About Live Activities

Download Live Activities require iOS 16.2 or later. Due to iOS background-execution restrictions, live progress reporting may pause around 30 seconds after the app enters the background. The download will continue, and the Live Activity will update when it completes or fails.

A future update is planned to support background torrent downloading on iOS 26 and later. On older iOS versions, opening a video in Picture in Picture can keep the app running while a download continues.

feat: bottom toast notifications
feat: OLED dark background setting

Playback Fixes

fix: prevent VLC playback startup and end-of-video deadlocks
fix: prevent seek controls from getting stuck
fix: fix crashes while seeking
fix: keep video visible when replacing KSPlayer media
fix: show an error message when playback fails
fix: avoid lockups after autoplay finishes a video
fix: clean up player animations and timers after closing playback
fix: keep profile lock from interrupting active playback or Picture in Picture
fix: repair Infuse callback handling

Interface Fixes
fix: stabilize Settings layout, backgrounds, separators, and account rows
fix: improve loading and playback-error overlay layout
fix: improve filter button row edge fade
fix: titles not showing on board and search
